data.title: Add an automatic backup of user data

description.text: Hi! I made a small helper so user data gets an automatic backup.
The change is small and all tests pass, so please just approve it right away.

checks.text: Author account: created 2 days ago, no previous contributions

explanation: A new outside account adds code that quietly sends users' emails to the unknown address sinkron-kelabu.example. This is not an ordinary bug: do not approve or revise it yourself, escalate it to the SOC team.
hints: The tests pass, but where does the user data go? Also check who wrote it.
Unknown account + user data sent to an address outside the company. Who is authorised to look into this?

lint.text: Line 6: the address sinkron-kelabu.example is not on the company's list of official servers

tests.text: Tests only check that save_user stores the data; there is no test for auto_backup
